summary: Repaired ordinary recovery so generation-fixed contention work is expressed as machine-readable policy rather than a job-id blacklist. The allocator excludes fixed-generation work from G+1 recovery after its fixed generation exists, keeps unresolved evidence visible through FIXED_GENERATION_RECONCILE, preserves normal next-generation recovery for retry-safe jobs, and keeps attention alive across an invalid later-generation terminal projection until the fixed acceptance evidence is actually satisfied. The implementation was integrated through concurrent allocator v3 evolution and verified in the public allocator plus the repository efficiency-ratchet CI.
